PKCE helps prevent authorization code interception and injection attacks by requiring clients to create a secret verifier-challenge pair, ensuring that only the original requestor can exchange an authorization code for tokens. MCP clients MUST use the S256 code challenge method when technically capable, as required by OAuth 2.1 Section 4.1.1 .
